reviewed_by: Codex focused review for command output efficiency
reason: Command receipts now include a complete bounded redacted preview of small process streams, with artifact-only fallback and provider guidance. Selected Python cases cover local and generic recorders, redaction, fallback, chat instructions, and harness receipts. The real-Core live-tool-activity browser journey checks the visible activity and refresh path on desktop and mobile. The additional command-broker case executes a command and checks that its receipt carries the preview.
exclusions: No full suite was authorized. Frontend and native source are unchanged, so those unit layers are excluded. Unrelated provider and browser journeys are excluded. Browser projects use emulation, not physical devices. The selected browser journey checks activity presentation; a production command-result workflow is verified separately after deployment.
